description: Creates an AgentDNA catalog for a company and returns its private API key (shown once) and the next steps. Free for 30 days, no card. Use only for a company you act for; the catalog is not verified until the domain owner proves the domain.

company.description: The company's name as customers know it.

description.description: Optional one or two sentences on what the company sells.

domain.description: The company's own domain, for example example.com.

email.description: Contact email for the catalog owner; billing notices go here.

name: agentdna_start_trial
title: Start a company's free 30-day catalog
